name: Garden Tool Bag Organizer
description:
Premium Material:
  • Crafted from durable 100% polyester fabric, this Garden Tool Bag Organizer is lightweight, sturdy, and designed for long-lasting outdoor use. 
  • The reinforced handles provide comfortable carrying, while the durable construction helps keep gardening tools organized and protected during daily tasks.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:

Overall Size: 15.75 in × 8.27 in × 3.54 in (40 × 21 × 9 cm)

The product is manually measured, so slight dimensional variations may occur.

 

Printing Technology:

Features sublimation printing technology that delivers vibrant colors, detailed artwork, and long-lasting print clarity. Personalized designs remain vivid and attractive even with regular outdoor use.

 

Functionality Use:
  • Designed with multiple exterior pockets and a spacious interior compartment, this organizer helps neatly store and carry gardening essentials such as hand trowels, pruners, gloves, spray bottles, seed packets, ropes, and other tools. 
  • Perfect for gardening, planting, yard work, farming activities, or general household organization.

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
  • A thoughtful and practical gift for gardeners, plant lovers, moms, grandmas, family members, friends, or anyone who enjoys outdoor activities. 
  • Ideal for birthdays, Mother’s Day, Christmas, gardening celebrations, housewarming parties, holidays, and special occasions.

 

Specification:
  • Processing Time: 5-7 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
